instruction: Query the OQMD database for all Li ternary compounds (element_set=Li AND ntypes=3), count total entries and how many have stability<0.01, and save both counts to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_9.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
